layers.text: Change only the colours: the red hood and robe become near-black charcoal with a thin bright violet trim along the hood's edge; the pale blue flame and his eyes become bright glowing violet, nothing blue is left; his face becomes pallid light ash grey; his beard becomes ivory-white. Keep the skull staff, the beard's shape, the face, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
